titolo: Il SUV da 45.000 euro costa DAVVERO 27.100 euro? Il conto reale dopo 5 anni
protagonista: Marco, Italian man about 42 years old, short dark brown hair, light stubble, wearing a navy blue polo shirt, beige chino trousers and white sneakers

copertina.sfondo: Marco, Italian man about 42 years old, short dark brown hair, light stubble, navy blue polo shirt, shocked expression, standing next to a brand new shiny mid-size SUV in a car dealership showroom, price tag on the windshield

scene.voce: Marco compra un SUV nuovo. Quarantacinquemila euro, a rate. Ma il prezzo sul cartellino non è il costo vero. Quanto costa davvero?

sfondi.descr: Marco, Italian man about 42 years old, short dark brown hair, light stubble, navy blue polo shirt, beige chino trousers, white sneakers, smiling in front of a brand new shiny mid-size SUV in a bright car dealership showroom, price tag on the windshield
Close-up of a car price tag on a car window in a dealership showroom, showing a large price, no people, no cars visible except the glass edge

scene.voce: In cinque anni Marco paga ventisettemilaseicento euro tra rate e interessi. Settemilacinquecento di benzina. Tremilacinquecento di assicurazione. Quattromila tra bollo, tagliandi e gomme. Duemilacinquecento tra parcheggi e pedaggi. Totale: quarantacinquemilacento euro.

sfondi.descr: Marco, Italian man about 42 years old, short dark brown hair, light stubble, navy blue polo shirt, beige chino trousers, white sneakers, signing a car financing contract at a desk in a car dealership, a new SUV visible through the glass behind him
Close-up of a petrol pump nozzle with the display showing liters and euros, at an Italian gas station, no people, no cars
Car insurance policy document and car keys on a wooden table, no people, no cars
Tools and tires in a mechanic workshop, an invoice on a workbench, no people, no cars
Coin-operated parking meter on an Italian city street with a toll ticket slip next to it, no people, no cars

scene.voce: E intanto il SUV perde valore. Oggi vale quarantacinquemila euro. Dopo cinque anni, solo diciottomila.

sfondi.descr: Marco, Italian man about 42 years old, short dark brown hair, light stubble, navy blue polo shirt, beige chino trousers, white sneakers, proudly standing next to a brand new, perfectly shiny mid-size SUV outdoors in front of his apartment building on a sunny day

Marco, Italian man about 47 years old, short dark brown hair with a few grey hairs, light stubble, navy blue polo shirt, beige chino trousers, white sneakers, standing next to the same mid-size SUV, now dusty with small scratches and dents, outdoors in a used car lot

scene.voce: Facciamo il conto. Pagato: quarantacinquemilacento euro. Rivendita: diciottomila. Il costo vero è ventisettemilacento euro. Sono quattrocentocinquantadue euro al mese. Quindici euro al giorno, ogni giorno.

sfondi.descr: Marco, Italian man about 42 years old, short dark brown hair, light stubble, navy blue polo shirt, sitting at a kitchen table at home with papers, receipts and a calculator, looking focused
Close-up of Marco, Italian man about 42 years old, short dark brown hair, light stubble, navy blue polo shirt, with a stunned, wide-eyed shocked face looking at a calculator in his hand, at home
An open empty wallet next to a wall calendar with days crossed out on a wooden table, no people, no cars

scene.voce: Come spendere meno? Compra un'auto usata di due anni. Confronta le assicurazioni ogni anno. E chiediti se ti serve davvero un SUV.

sfondi.descr: Marco, Italian man about 42 years old, short dark brown hair, light stubble, navy blue polo shirt, beige chino trousers, white sneakers, looking at a two-year-old mid-size SUV in a used car dealership lot outdoors
Laptop screen showing an insurance price comparison website with several quotes, on a desk next to a coffee cup, no people, no cars

scene.voce: Prossima puntata: quanto costa davvero un cane?
